purpose: Freeze Pair 5 lived relationship phenotype before birth-derived astrology is inspected.

relationship_context.economic_context: economic strain in Mexico contributed to relationship stress/breakup context

partner_to_user.sexual_habituation_pattern: partner reportedly became bored with familiar male partners and needed novelty/new partners to experience sex strongly
partner_to_user.religious_worldview_influence: partner attempted to move reference actor toward Christianity despite not being strongly observant herself

dyadic.community_lifestyle_alignment: reference_actor_preferred_more_community_living; partner was less aligned initially but became more open later

new_model_requirement.sexual_novelty_habituation: Separate baseline libido and actor attraction from novelty dependence / habituation rate. A person can have substantial libido and strong initial sex but low long-term sexual stability with familiar partners.
new_model_requirement.longitudinal_sex_model: Sexual compatibility must include time-dependent novelty decay or stability, not only initial chemistry.
new_model_requirement.autonomy_domain_specificity: Low general drama can coexist with strong local reactance to being directed or controlled in specific behavioral domains.
new_model_requirement.historical_stage_confounding: Spiritual/worldview compatibility must be rated relative to who each person was during the relationship, not current identity projected backward.

currently_missing_or_uncertain: Reference actor's relative physical attraction ranking compared with other partners.
Partner baseline libido independent of novelty dependence.
Partner romantic/Eros intensity versus companionate love.
Jealousy/exclusivity pattern, especially sexual versus romantic jealousy.
How much partner desired long-term commitment/marriage with reference actor.
Conflict repair quality when actual disagreements occurred.
Whether low drama reflected genuine emotional ease or simply low conflict exposure/style.
Degree of intellectual commonality versus simply adequate communication.
Whether partner's novelty dependence was specific to sex, relationships generally, or both.
Relationship duration/cohabitation/contact intensity for longitudinal normalization.
chart_blind_rule: Do not inspect or fit Pair 5 astrology until this phenotype is preserved. When birth data arrive, score against the current frozen AstroRRF V0.3 and any explicitly versioned V0.4 extension created before chart inspection.
